experiments.scope: The claimed program (the VOL40 v7e generator, then every pair shifted to schedule words -19..-4, all bit-sliced and counted) (proof Sections 2-3) per organizer trial: 256 lanes of pairs from the standard IV with the hard op cap; per kept lane the shifted candidate pair and its J45 landing count; on the first 16 kept lanes of the batch the full 59-word schedule control, the sliced-vs-word control, the forced-target tail to step 59 and the bit-30 negative control; per-bit tallies on the first 32 kept lanes.
experiments.hypothesis: All kept lanes pass both controls; landing at k bits occurs at rate 2^-k (premise P1); every pair at the target collides after step 59 (premise P2) and the negative control never does; no full collision is expected at organizer scale.
